svg.text: Deployed DEV design · us-east-1 · synthetic policy corpus · November 3, 2026
Sign-in returns an access token to the browser.
Session storage · no browser AWS credentials
CORS permits the exact hosted origin.
No VPC, NAT or private endpoints
Blue: request / retrieval flow Green dashed: document ingestion Responses return along the request path.
DEV scope: WAF disabled · no persistent chat history · no tenant/document isolation · references are not verified citations.
